title: Nine Pints of Tin
subtitle: 食堂与水壶 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 食堂与水壶（生活与学习·校园与出行）
meta: 主题语境：食堂与水壶（生活与学习·校园与出行）　|　核心词汇：canteen　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 canteen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1943 my mother was sent to fill ① a canteen she could not carry, and she said the carrying was the whole of the lesson. The ② canteen, meaning the flask and not the room, was nine pints and was filled by whoever came last; a canteen, she said, is the only thing in a barracks that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ canteen in that barracks had the same strap, and the ④ canteen at the end, meaning the one the sergeant kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever filled properly. A canteen, my grandmother said, is nine parts tin and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the tin is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ canteen was the whole of the march, meaning the march it watered and not the flask. The ⑥ canteen, meaning the march and not any of that, is the only thing in a battalion that everybody shares and nobody questions; a canteen, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a flask and a march. She said the march is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ canteen had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the strap. The ⑧ canteen of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pints and eleven years of filling; a canteen, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ canteen I remember is the one at the end, which was emptied in 1966 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ canteen, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every canteen, she said, is a march that has agreed to look like a flask. She said the march was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 水壶（指那只水壶本身，与餐厅相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill a canteen 装满一只水壶
D. n. 水壶（指营房里每一只）
E. n. 水壶（指末尾那一只）
F. n. 水壶（抽象：它供水的那次行军）
G. n. 那次行军（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a canteen she could not carry
The canteen, meaning the flask and not the room
canteen was the whole of the march
the canteen had become a photograph in a report
The canteen of the whole thing
A canteen, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: fill a canteen 意为“装满一只水壶”，1943 年母亲被派去装满一只她提不动的水壶。
canteen 意为“水壶”，指那只水壶本身而不是餐厅，装得下九品脱，由最后走的人灌满。
canteen 指营房里每一只水壶，每一只都是同样的背带。
canteen 指末尾那一只（中士留的那一只），是唯一有人认真灌满过的。
canteen 意为“水壶”，抽象指它供水的那次行军，父亲说 canteen 就是那次行军的全部。
canteen 为抽象用法，指那次行军本身，是营里人人都分着喝、却没人质疑的东西。
canteen 意为“水壶、食堂”，到 1961 年这只 canteen 成了报告里的一张照片。
canteen 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九品脱和十一年的灌水。
canteen 意为“水壶”，我记得的是末尾那一只，1966 年喝空，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
canteen 为抽象总称，祖母说水壶是唯一会因为被分着喝而变好的东西。
